pictures.scale: thylakoid membrane: ATP synthase and pump with the gradient
pictures.shows: 16:9 glossy scientific cutaway inside a chloroplast: complete closed flattened thylakoid sac, emerald membrane enclosing amber lumen, turquoise stroma outside, neighboring stacked discs. On the right membrane at 72,48 a physically proportioned ATP synthase silhouette has amber CF0, gold stalk and violet stromal CF1 head. Preserve realistic relative scale. Transparent section reveals enclosed lumen without a physical opening. Leave open space for proton populations and subsequent camera approach to the right membrane. No text.

pictures.scale: thylakoid membrane: the gradient breaking down
pictures.shows: 16:9 closer cutaway inside the previous right thylakoid membrane region. Emerald membrane horizontally at y58, amber enclosed lumen below, turquoise stroma above. Sac curvature remains at edges. Small realistic ATP synthase on right x72 has amber CF0 ring, gold stalk, violet six-lobed stromal CF1 head. Surrounding membrane retains depth. Leave open proton paths from lumen at 62,77 through CF0 at 72,58 to stroma at 81,43. No physical membrane leak, no text.

pictures.scale: ATP synthase close up: CF0 in the membrane, CF1 above
pictures.shows: 16:9 magnified structural cutaway of the same right-side ATP synthase. Emerald bilayer at y62, amber enclosed lumen below, turquoise stroma above. On right x68 amber CF0 rotor ring and stationary subunit with proton access half-channels span membrane; gold central stalk and peripheral stator support violet six-lobed CF1 head at 68,30 facing stroma. Small upper-left contextual inset shows same closed emerald thylakoid with amber lumen. Leave clear proton route from 58,80 through ring to 79,48. No labels.

pictures.scale: ATP synthase close up: H+ channel from pump to CF0
pictures.shows: 16:9 closer view inside previous CF0 membrane region. Emerald bilayer horizontal y60, amber lumen below with visibly higher proton population space, turquoise stroma above. Same right-side amber CF0 rotor at x68,y60, stationary access half-channels, gold stalk leading to violet six-lobed CF1 head at x68,y24, peripheral stator. Maintain both compartments and surrounding bilayer. Open route from lumen 57,80 through 62,67 and 69,60 to stromal exit 79,44. No arrows or text.

pictures.scale: ATP synthase close up: CF1 head where ATP is made
pictures.shows: 16:9 closer structural cutaway of the same right ATP synthase. Emerald membrane y65, amber lumen below, turquoise stroma above. Amber CF0 ring and stationary half-channels at x66,y65, gold central stalk at x66,y49, violet six-lobed CF1 head x66,y31, peripheral stator. Expose catalytic cleft 72,30 with distinguishable open and closed lobes in the actual head. Leave stromal ADP approach from 43,20, phosphate from 48,43 and product exit to 88,20. Preserve membrane context; no floating duplicate protein states or prepainted molecules.

pictures.scale: stroma: ATP and NADPH reaching the stroma
pictures.shows: 16:9 enter turquoise stroma just above previous right ATP synthase. Emerald membrane lower edge, amber lumen below. Same right amber CF0, gold stalk and violet six-lobed CF1 head at 73,70 facing stroma. NADPH producing reduction site left at 35,73. Open fluid biosynthesis region at 53,37 with dispersed realistic globular enzymes and structural Rubisco active site 54,34 holding a small organic acceptor. Clear routes from membrane supplies and CO2 from upper left. No boxes or painted intermediates.

pictures.scale: stroma: enzymes that use ATP and NADPH
pictures.shows: 16:9 closer view inside preceding stromal biosynthesis region. Glossy turquoise fluid, dispersed realistically shaped globular enzymes, uncrowded reaction space. Same violet six-lobed CF1 head at lower right 81,73, gold stalk toward narrow emerald membrane strip with amber lumen beyond. Supply paths from lower right and lower left, carbon entry upper left and sugar exit right. Preserve biological scale and continuity; no imaginary enzyme converting CO2 directly to glucose, no boxes, no prepainted molecules.

pictures.scale: everyday: a real dam and its turbine
pictures.shows: 16:9 photorealistic hydroelectric dam, high reservoir left, concrete barrier centre, realistic engineering cutaway turbine right 65,62, low tailwater right. Separate visible leaking joint 46,46 drains to tailwater bypassing turbine. Warm ivory sunlight and moss-green landscape. Clear mapping-label space. Small paired biological inset: deep-teal membrane, enclosed gold lumen, ivory stroma, amber CF0, copper stalk, violet CF1.

pictures.scale: everyday: a real dam keeping the water difference
pictures.shows: 16:9 photorealistic separate view of same dam powerhouse. High reservoir upper-left, concrete dam centre-left, motor-driven pump left, steel turbine right 69,58, low tailwater bottom-right. Distinct uphill pump pipe and downhill turbine penstock. Warm ivory sunlight, realistic concrete and metal, clear mapping-label space.
